items.summary: Update the Pinata directory upload implementation so uploading a generated collection to Pinata no longer fails with HTTP 400: {"error":"More than one file and/or directory was provided for pinning."}. This includes adjusting the multipart/form-data payload sent to https://api.pinata.cloud/pinning/pinFileToIPFS to match Pinata’s directory upload expectations when multiple files are provided (and the request must still use JWT Bearer auth).

Ensure the image URI paths in generated metadata remain correct after the directory-upload payload change (e.g., if files are uploaded under a directory prefix/path, metadata must reference ipfs://<imageDirCID>/<correct relative path>).
